text:
dmitri: Heads up — release promo into prod is blocked, preflight e2e failing in CI on the browser binary fetch step. seen in 3 consecutive runs.
carla: logs?
dmitri: snippet: `ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE` when pulling https://artifacts.internal.redwood/browser-bridge/v2/linux-x64.tar.gz — 404/timeout mix. looks like S3 object missing or TTL cleanup raced.
ben: hmm could be our artifact GC TTL + upload lag after the build. last-green image is sha: sha123abc.
carla: can we reupload the asset from the builder node that still has it? or fallback to the previous image?
dmitri: builder node was ephemeral, we only have the published image. if we repush the asset we need to coordinate with registry ops (slow).
eve: change window is in 2 hours. i'd prefer a quick pin to last-green and manual promote so customers not impacted. cc @deploybot to confirm promote command. :eyes:
ben: agreed. we should pin service image to sha123abc for this cut. that buys time to investigate artifact TTL.
deploybot: Automated note — promotion requires manual approval due to non-fastforward. Use `deploybot promote --sha=sha123abc --env=prod --reason="preflight artifact fetch failure"` and add approver.
carla: I can approve once infra confirms the image is intact. can someone run a smoke in staging with the pinned sha?
dmitri: running now: `kubectl -n staging set image deploy/api api=repo/api:sha123abc && kubectl rollout status deploy/api`
dmitri: staging smoke passed (quick checks).
eve: ok let's hold prod promo until PM notified and release notes updated. PM on call is @carla for this cut.
ben: also filing a short postmortem/incident with artifact TTL timeline and a proposal to increase retention for preflight artifacts.
carla: decision: pin to sha123abc, manual promote with deploybot, hold change window if any further failures, followup incident doc.
dmitri: i've triggered `deploybot promote --sha=sha123abc --env=prod --manual` and left a note in the promotion. waiting on approval.
deploybot: Promotion job queued. approver required: carla.
carla: approved. proceeding. :thumbsup:
deploybot: Promotion started. streaming logs...
deploybot: Promotion complete — prod now on sha123abc. Rollback plan: revert to previous sha on failure — contact oncall (ben) and run `deploybot rollback --env=prod --to-sha=<prev>`
eve: thanks team. capturing action items: (1) incident doc + TTL root cause (ben), (2) adjust artifact GC or preflight push delay (infra), (3) add health-check in pipeline to fail faster on missing artifacts (dmitri).
ben: noted. I'll shepherd the incident and propose retention delta.
dmitri: will add the pipeline health-check PR now.
carla: closing thread for the release cut. we'll reopen if any abnormalities in the next 30m.
